action: Use legume cover crops and retain crop residues.
reason: Organic inputs can increase soil organic matter and improve soil structure and moisture retention.

action: Increase soil cover using mulch and drought-tolerant native vegetation.
reason: Vegetative and residue cover can reduce direct soil evaporation and improve water retention.
source: FAO soil and water conservation guidance

action: Introduce native flowering strips and mixed vegetation.
reason: Habitat and vegetation diversity can provide food and shelter for a wider range of organisms.

action: Introduce crop rotation and intercropping with compatible species.
reason: Diversification can increase habitat heterogeneity and reduce dependence on a single crop system.

action: Create native vegetation corridors between fragmented habitat patches.
reason: Connectivity can improve movement between habitat patches and support ecological processes.

action: Establish vegetated buffer zones around water channels.
reason: Vegetated buffers can intercept sediment and some pollutants before they reach aquatic systems.

action: Increase native vegetation cover and maintain shaded habitat patches.
reason: Vegetation can modify local microclimates and provide thermal refuge for organisms.
